seed: The captions mock draws Lower third low on the left, inside title safe, on its own violet plate (docs/design/mocks/pages/video-captions.html, STYLES.B). At Next defaults with no flag set: a talking recording gets its captions, Lower third is picked and the Captions layer moves to the title-safe left edge on the violet plate, a film written out draws it there too, and picking Caption puts the captions back where they were.

steps.note: Captions written in the standard Caption style: centred on the title-safe floor on a dark plate.
Lower third picked: the captions move to the title-safe left edge, bold, on the mock's violet plate, in the font and size they had.
A film written out with the captions burned in: started-at-1080p.mp4 in this walk's folder draws the lower third where the canvas does.
Caption picked again: the captions go back to where they were, centred.
